summary_1line: Bharata hears from Guha how Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana spent their first exile night fasting on grass by the Ganges while Lakshmana kept vigilant guard.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Sita sleep on a simple bed of kusa grass beneath an Ingudi tree while Lakshmana, bow drawn and quiver full, paces guard in the moonlit night.
Bharata collapses unconscious upon hearing Guha’s tale as the grieving queens and Shatrughna gather around him.
Lakshmana kneels to wash the feet of Rama and Sita beside the quiet riverbank before taking up his vigil.
